note:
R88 - correction checkpoint for the 24 September coordinator review (F1 / F2 / F3): re-measure the R86 (team artid identity +
references) and R87 (row allocation) rows on witnessed sources, with a SHA-256 for every input, and audit the stat-table membership
behind the "one row per NHL club" statement.

Sources (each row carries db / meta path + SHA-256 and a provenance label):
  the 25 committed anchors (X360 / PS3 08-Legacy, PS4 15-21) - `anchors/ps4/nhl20` is labelled "MISLABELED: NHL 19 base copy" and
    its measurements are retained only as that;
  ps4/nhl19-base      = the anchor (NHL 19 base `inxp_00.big` member; identical bytes to the CUSA11126 install member);
  ps4/nhl19-patch56   = `nhl_game.db` from the CUSA11126 install's `patch_inxp_56.big` (no meta member in the patch archives: read with
                        the base meta; the table set is compared and any mismatch recorded);
  ps4/nhl20-install   = `nhl_game.db` + `nhl_game-meta.xml` from the CUSA15439 install's `inxp_00.big` (the real NHL 20).
Omitted, stated: NHL 07 (gen6 schema, no `exhibitionteams`), Legacy Recompiled (no independent anchor; shares the Legacy X360 DB by
the repository's scope statement, not measured here), the other NHL 19 patch archives 51-55 (not extracted).

F2 audit: for every team-keyed stat / history / record table, the league membership (and names) of the team indexes that hold rows.
F3 audit (Legacy X360): destination occupancy of the "free" art ids against the asset-only id populations of the 2026-09-18 join JSON
and against every artid-keyed DB column's values outside the team set.
Usage: python r88_correction_sources.py <nhl19-patch56-db> <nhl20-install-db> <nhl20-install-meta> <out.json>
